main.description: Set the caller's contact email in their preferences space, and send a link to it that proves it. Until the link is opened, the address they had stays in use. Setting the proven address they already have drops a change that is waiting. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per action and resends on every retry of it.

sent.description: Whether a link was sent. False when the address is already theirs and proven.

verified.description: Whether the address is already proven, so nothing waits.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working; present when sent.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a customer nor staff, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, or the provisioner refused it as malformed.

errors.name: InvalidEmail
errors.description: The address is not an email address.

errors.name: TooManyLinks
errors.description: Five links have been sent to this account in the last 24 hours.

errors.name: EmailFailed
errors.description: The email could not be sent; nothing was recorded, so it is safe to try again.

errors.name: EmailNotConfigured
errors.description: Owner email is not switched on yet.

errors.name: InvalidLink
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner. Not expected here; declared because every contact-email refusal is mapped the same way.
